pages.text: Find a naturally generated sculk shrieker in the Deep Dark and cause a Warden to emerge. The encounter belongs to the team recorded when that Warden is summoned.$(br2)The summoner or a member of that same team must defeat that same Warden. Both the summoner and the player credited with the kill must still belong to the recorded team when it dies.

An outsider taking the kill does not unlock either team. Coordinate the encounter with your teammates and avoid involving another team in the finishing hit.$(br2)Playing solo? Summon and defeat the Warden yourself.
